agillm_nat_source.finding: The NAT pathway supplies prefix plus BLANK suffix to the shared core without a causal mask, then projects token logits across positions. Its corruption schedule includes suffix spans. The shared historical core uses LayerNorm and an attention/FFN stack.
agillm_nat_source.not_reproduced: This experiment is not an exact production AGILLM checkpoint or training script. It uses a tiny full-precision dense RMSNorm/RoPE/squared-ReLU Transformer inspired by the later AGILLM packed128b core, and a deliberately fixed full-suffix NAT objective. Production routing, quantization, tokenizer, model size and mixed AR/SAT/NAT objectives are excluded.

agillm_later_core_reference.inspected: forward, approximately lines 215-255: RMSNorm, RoPE, attention, squared-ReLU expert FFN
